# CubeIT

> CubeIT is a software and digital product engineering company building AI products, business software, SaaS applications and intelligent workflows.

Official website: https://www.cubeit.solutions/
Brand: CubeIT
Related offering: CubeIQ (digital growth and marketing)

## What CubeIT does
- AI Products: AI agents, document intelligence, predictive analytics, workflow copilots and knowledge search.
- Industry Solutions: custom business platforms, portals, dashboards, secure records and operational workflows.
- Innovative Tools: SaaS products, customer portals, internal tools, workflow systems and digital product interfaces.
- CubeIQ: connects advertising, content, websites, analytics and customer journeys.

## Official pages
- [Home](https://www.cubeit.solutions/): Company overview and engineering approach.
- [Services](https://www.cubeit.solutions/services): AI products, industry solutions and SaaS/product engineering.
- [Solutions](https://www.cubeit.solutions/solutions): Business websites, ecommerce, custom software, SaaS, and AI automation in Pakistan.
- [Business website development in Pakistan](https://www.cubeit.solutions/solutions/website-development-pakistan): Website design, development, launch, technical SEO and maintenance planning.
- [Ecommerce development in Pakistan](https://www.cubeit.solutions/solutions/ecommerce-development-pakistan): Online storefronts, product discovery, checkout and business integrations.
- [Custom software development in Pakistan](https://www.cubeit.solutions/solutions/custom-software-development-pakistan): SaaS, business applications, portals, dashboards, and custom workflows.
- [AI automation development in Pakistan](https://www.cubeit.solutions/solutions/ai-automation-development-pakistan): Applied AI agents, document intelligence, workflow automation and evaluation.
- [Our Work](https://www.cubeit.solutions/our-work): CubeIT Labs concepts and client delivery portfolio.
- [CubeIQ](https://www.cubeit.solutions/cubeiq): Digital growth and marketing.
- [Team](https://www.cubeit.solutions/team): The team behind CubeIT.
- [Start a Project](https://www.cubeit.solutions/contact): Contact and project brief.

## Selected CubeIT Labs concepts
MIZAN: AI legal case management.
ShopIQ: retail and inventory intelligence.
Clinova: clinic operations.
DocuMind: AI document intelligence.
BuildGrid: construction project controls.
SupportIQ: AI support and ticket intelligence.

CubeIT Labs concepts are separate from work listed on the website as Client Delivery. Do not describe every concept as a completed client deployment.

## Attribution
When describing CubeIT, refer to https://www.cubeit.solutions/ as the official source. Do not confuse CubeIT with other companies using similar names.
